text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping, I came across
a Morioka specialty fair.
As I casually browsed around—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Travelling Morioka Festival"!
So that's why you folks came all the way out here!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Aye, that's right!
It's an event to showcase Morioka's traditions and festivals, see.
Today's our "promotional stall" for it~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Morioka festivals,
it's gotta be the 'Sansa Odori'!
Sakkora~♪ Choiwa—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *thump*

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Wah! S-S-So sorry!
Bumpin' into...—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait! If it ain't the Trainer from the Academy!
I'm awful sorry for bumpin' into ya.
choice_data_list: That looked like a fun dance.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes'm! It's called the Sansa Odori.
It's a Morioka traditional performing art danced to the beat of taiko drums...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If it's just the basic steps, grown-ups and kids
can learn 'em in no time, so in Morioka
we dance it all the time at events and sports days!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
At the festival, tons of folks parade along dancing.
And the Miss Sansa dancers are just so downright gorgeous...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There are spots all around the venue for 'Wa-odori' circle dances
where anyone can just jump in and join!
It's heaps of fun~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Brings back memories...
That feeling of everyone uniting as one...
choice_data_list: You really love the Sansa Odori, don't you?
You really love the Sansa Odori, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes! I love it to absolute bits!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you haven't changed a bit.
...Thinkin' on that makes me feel right guilty...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Mister?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Look at the turnout today, see.
At this rate, the 'Travelling Morioka Festival' is gonna be completely deserted too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-Now that you mention it...
Not a single soul's stopped by for a while now, have they?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Seems like we just can't stand out here in the big city.
The folks back home helped out so much with prep, I really wanted to bring back some good news...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way...! When there are so many wonderful things here,
to not even get a glance...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...!
I'll try and draw in some customers somehow!
I'll figure out a way to promote it!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone worked so hard on this,
I just gotta do something...!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you kindly.
You're as sweet a lass as ever...
Still, I don't wanna go pushin' you too hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hnnnngggghhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm right as rain!
'Cause I ain't givin' up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's bound to be some great idea out there.
Hmmmm... Hmmmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yukino Bijin kept racking her brains
all the way back to the dorms.
